sam: Preflight: midnight cutover planned. API v2.7.3, runtime 3.4.1, router 4.0.10, console 1.9.3. Change window 00:00-02:00 UTC. Canary: 5% x15m -> 25% x30m. @maria runtime, @leo router please ack any blockers.

tess: ack. Quick note: router 4.0.10 includes new edge filter that should respect ROUTER_COMPRESS flag; ensure it's off for canary until console confirms.

maria: ack. Runtime build has kv-eviction tweak; i want eviction=0.72 for canary. I'll publish runtime:3.4.1-ev0.72.

leo: I'll deploy router with ROUTER_COMPRESS=false for canary and run smoke. Also watching memory footprint.

deploybot: wave queued rw-17487. Canary config: {"pct":5,"duration_min":15,"abort_on":["p99>800ms","5xx>0.3%"]}

sre-bot: dashboards set. Baselines p50 130ms p95 340ms p99 700ms.

deploybot: canary started at 00:05 UTC. api and runtime variants deployed. router canary with ROUTER_COMPRESS=false rolling.

maria: seeing p99 up to 840ms on some runtime nodes, kv_fetch latencies spiking in logs.

sam: abort threshold reached. Maria please rollback runtime if that persists. Leo hold router ramp.

maria: rolling runtime back to 3.4.0 now.

deploybot: rollback initiated by maria. Runtime rollback complete at 00:22 UTC. Canary paused at 5%. p99 returned to 680ms, errors stable.

sam: good coordination. Action items: 1) extended staging for eviction tuning, 2) router filter test to validate flag behavior, 3) update release notes to call out runtime variant. Reschedule window after fixes.

leo: filing router filter PR and running a quick staging validation.

tess: i'll coordinate console flag flip only after router PR lands.

sam: thanks team, closing this window."
